course.title: Vector, Matrix and Ordinary Differential Equation

content.value: Determine the values of a so that the following system $x + y - z = 1$ $2 x + 3 y + a z = 3$ $x + a y + 3 z = 2$ has (i) no solution, (ii) infinite solution, (iii) a unique solution.
